headline: Salesforce plans acquisition of Braze to expand marketing tools
summary: Enterprise software giant Salesforce announced plans to acquire Braze to strengthen its marketing business offerings.
why: Strategic mergers and acquisitions allow large software corporations to consolidate market share, expand product ecosystems, and drive future revenue growth.
